format_boundary: Review views over existing contracts; not a new runtime schema, global registry, or Canonical Store.

step4_prerequisite.accepted_effect_boundary: Reuse the existing scoped Step4 administrative acceptance; this candidate issues no new acceptance, runtime authority or Freeze.

representations.subject: authenticated online Canonical objects
representations.write_rule: existing authenticated M1/API/MCP writers only; no new writer created here

representations.subject: repository memory/ two-level/five-view snapshot
representations.write_rule: read-only; current-use checks require its exact existing manifest/trust contract; no business memory loaded for this candidate

representations.subject: snapshot Markdown/current docs and derived indexes
representations.write_rule: cannot reverse-write or resolve a Canonical conflict from prose alone

representations.subject: immutable review ZIP and its original members
representations.write_rule: preserve original bytes; container and member digests are different evidence subjects

representations.subject: current author candidate Registry/model/documents
representations.write_rule: source-bound design only; a changed current candidate requires new revision/digest and applicable independent review

representations.subject: historical contract and future explicitly mapped consumer projection
representations.write_rule: historical read only; future exact compatibility entry must declare its actual consumer/role/host and expiry

logical_identity_rule: JSON and Markdown or regenerated bytes share a logical object only when existing source envelopes/derivation bind that identity; extension, title or byte equality does not establish it.
conflict_resolution: For business state use authenticated Canonical identity/version and verified projections. For design use exact source registry/subject and accepted decision when issued. Conflicting unbound representations remain disputed; no newest-filename or prose-wins heuristic.
regeneration: Changed bytes produce a new representation/artifact digest and any required revision; retain the stable logical ID only with an explicit owning-contract provenance binding.
